docs.summary: Provides canvas drawing methods for AnimationCurve preview swatches and the full curve editor graph, including grid, rulers, keyframe handles, and tangent lines.

members.name: DrawPreview
members.signature: public static void DrawPreview(Canvas canvas, Rect r, AnimationCurve curve, OrigamiTheme theme)

docs.summary: Draws a simplified preview of the curve within the given rectangle, using the theme's green color. Does nothing when the curve has no keys.

members.name: DrawGraph
members.signature: public static void DrawGraph(Canvas canvas, Rect r, AnimationCurve curve, float vMinT, float vMaxT, float vMinV, float vMaxV, OrigamiTheme theme, int selectedIdx)

docs.summary: Draws the full curve editor graph including grid lines, zero axes, the curve line, keyframe dots, and tangent lines for the selected key.

members.name: DrawRulerH
members.signature: public static void DrawRulerH(Canvas canvas, Rect r, float minT, float maxT, Scribe.FontFile? font)

docs.summary: Draws a horizontal ruler with tick marks and time labels along the top of the graph area.

members.name: DrawRulerV
members.signature: public static void DrawRulerV(Canvas canvas, Rect r, float minV, float maxV, Scribe.FontFile? font)

docs.summary: Draws a vertical ruler with tick marks and value labels along the left side of the graph area.

members.name: GetTangentScreenPos
members.signature: public static (float x, float y) GetTangentScreenPos(float kx, float ky, float tangent, float dir, float tToX, float vToY)

docs.summary: Computes the screen-space position of a tangent handle endpoint given the keyframe position, tangent slope, direction, and scale factors.

members.name: GetBounds
members.signature: public static void GetBounds(AnimationCurve curve, out float minT, out float maxT, out float minV, out float maxV)

docs.summary: Computes padded bounds for the curve's time and value ranges, sampling at PreviewSteps intervals. Returns default bounds (0,1,0,1) when the curve has no keys.

members.name: GetNiceStep
members.signature: public static float GetNiceStep(float range, float pixels, float minPixelStep)

docs.summary: Returns a 'nice' step size for grid or ruler tick marks, given the data range, available pixel space, and minimum pixel spacing.
